regions.label: ring-shaped paneled roof canopy forming the outermost band of the bowl; outer edge coincides with the stadium silhouette, seating rows remain visible inside its inner edge

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 顶视最外环为灰蓝色面板顶棚，外缘即体育场轮廓外接框（u 0.039-0.960 / v 0.041-0.959，由 v=0.50 行与 u=0.50 列的非白行程实测，圆角矩形）；顶棚内缝在四向中心颜色剖面实测：西 u≈0.1475-0.1541、东 u≈0.846-0.853、北 v≈0.2157-0.2243（南按对称估计 v≈0.776-0.784）；内缝以内直接露出浅蓝灰座位带，顶视未见顶棚覆盖座位排。ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 同一环状顶棚斜视清晰，同心面板分格与内侧檐口可见。bounds 取顶视轮廓外接框。

regions.label: concentric tiered seating bowl of pale blue-grey seat rows with radial aisle gaps between seat blocks; dark band along its inner rim listed separately

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 座位环外缘（顶棚内缝外沿）西 u≈0.154 / 东 u≈0.846 / 北 v≈0.224 / 南 v≈0.777，内缘西 u≈0.238 / 东 u≈0.764 / 北 v≈0.295 / 南 v≈0.706（RGB 颜色剖面蓝灰带起止实测）；环带内细条纹座位排与规律放射状过道间隙清晰，西带过道间距≈0.0276u，并见更深色同心分带线（西带 v≈0.468/0.515/0.563）。ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 斜视中碗盆多排高差与放射过道同见，内缘与场地之间有连贯深色带（另列 object）。bounds 取顶视环带外接框（环形区域，包络含中空场地）。

regions.label: green football pitch with light-dark mowing checkerboard, white marking network and surrounding lighter green apron

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 绿色连通域外接框 px(429,416)-(1368,984)（1797x1400）；白线网络亮线剖面实测：球门线 u≈0.269/0.7385，边线 v≈0.3004/0.6714，中线 u≈0.5025，中圈圆心(0.5035,0.4855)半径≈0.044u 含中心点，大禁区线 u≈0.3472/0.6599（v 0.3693-0.6028），小禁区线 u≈0.2947/0.7126（v 0.4329-0.5397），草面明暗棋盘格清晰。ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 绿色场地斜视同见，斜视中场地远侧见顶棚/看台投影暗斑。bounds 取顶视绿色域外接框。

regions.label: white perimeter fascia wall band below the roof edge carrying gold lettering, crest badges and a large mural (all listed as objects); hidden under the roof overhang in the top view

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-ne/nw/se/sw: 四斜视均见白色外墙上带，上有金色 'SLNA FC' 字样、盾形队徽与大幅球员彩绘，环绕可见各立面；ground-material-top: 顶视中被顶棚外缘遮挡，墙带无独立像素（顶视场内 0 个暗色<95 连通域、无高饱和连通域），仅以外轮廓边缘为包络，故 bounds 取顶视轮廓外接框（包络非墙带实际几何）。

entities.label: white pitch marking network: touchlines, goal lines, halfway line, centre circle with centre spot, penalty areas, goal areas and corner arcs

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 白线网络各线位置由亮线行/列剖面实测（数值同 playing-pitch 注）；线宽约 2-3px，边线/球门线连续，中圈为完整圆环+中心点，两端大/小禁区与球门区线完整，四角见角球弧迹。bounds 取 goal-line 至 goal-line、touchline 至 touchline 的标线范围外接框。

entities.label: white goal frame with net at the west goal line, net threads visible as fine bright texture; function as goal certified by shape/position on the goal line

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 西端球门线（u≈0.269）以西（场外）白色团块（≈2220px）含细网线纹理，v 跨 0.453-0.518，骑跨/紧贴门线；门线以西另见深绿窄带（u 0.246-0.252，门后深色衬/阴影，未单列）。ground-material-ne: 场地端部见白色门架迹（斜视分辨率下未逐一定位）。bounds 取顶视白色结构外接框。

entities.label: white goal frame with net at the east goal line, net threads visible as fine bright texture; function as goal certified by shape/position on the goal line

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 东端球门线（u≈0.7385）以东（场外）白色团块（≈2424px）含细网线纹理，v 跨 0.456-0.518；门线以内侧另见深绿窄条（u 0.7326-0.7392，门前深色棋盘格/阴影，未单列）。bounds 取顶视白色结构外接框。

entities.label: two white-outlined rectangles on the south apron flanking the halfway line (green interiors); function unresolved (dugout/bench hypothesis, not certified)

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-top: 南边线（v≈0.6714）南侧草面 apron 上两个白描边矩形：西者 u 0.405-0.487、东者 u 0.520-0.608，v 0.694-0.704，中线 u≈0.5025 从二者之间通过；顶缘 v 0.694-0.696 为亮色横带，内部为草色。ground-material-ne: 远侧边线外相应位置仅见细窄色带，不足以确认形态。功能无像素证据，按 unknown_function 登记。

entities.label: dark display panel with colored content mounted high on the inner rim of the north-to-northwest upper stand; function unknown (scoreboard/screen hypothesis, not certified)

visual_note.visual_note: ground-material-ne: 远侧上区暗色板带彩色内容（px (896,432)-(960,460)，左侧邻接彩斑 (770,436)-(810,468)）；ground-material-se: 对应位置暗/红/黄混合小面 ≈px (437,430)-(520,465)；两视中该板均位于上位看台内缘高处、远离各自机位的一侧。ground-material-top: 顶视场内无任何暗色（<95 连通域为 0）或高饱和像素，该板在顶视不可见，bounds 取北-西北内缘上排候选包络，东西分量存在机位假设歧义（见 uncertainties），整体记 layout_inferred。

entities.label: large exterior mural artwork (player figure in yellow/blue with crowd and ball) on the white fascia, appearing on every visible facade
